## Checklist

- [ ] Tests written first and passing (`npm run test`, `npm run e2e`)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run check:package` pass
- [ ] Public API changes are documented in the README with doc comments on the types
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader behavior checked in a browser
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
